items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: John Thomas and that bunch... They were all with him during that period. Yes, I remember. That was before I came in.

ctx.x: Yes, I remember those days. I heard them then.
John Thomas and that bunch. Eddie Pearson who was dead. They were all with him during that period. Yes, I remember. That was before I came in. Yes. And then when I came in, they all remained.

During that time, did you, I know you wouldn't have given up music, but did you play out in the public at all with any bands or by yourself or… Do you mean before I came to… No, in that period between 1935 when you were raising your family. Oh, yes.
